supersedes.reason: The second independent review confirmed the documented encoded-route fixes but found decoded scheme-prefixed links could still inherit local workspace semantics. This manifest binds exact scheme-prefix rejection, stale aria-current cleanup, and keyboard exclusion in the real production bundle.

checks.result: The exact second-remediation commit passed all 24 desktop-profile commands in 463.82 seconds, including 146 foundation tests, 22 desktop tests, all native/application commands, the complete approved UI matrix, and the expanded real-bundle recovery boundary. Report SHA-256: 3889fe4197518fd97d32f0943e6647e607c1fc732210d4de1b85eb73c6e97d29.

All eight locked renderer/native commands passed. The production bundle activated all 32 pages, recovered six unsafe route inputs, rejected two scheme-prefixed navigation hrefs, removed stale current-page semantics, excluded those links from keyboard routing, and made zero unexpected requests. Report SHA-256: 55e547d1344cc6e31d839984a702bf8be86e41238c9d2c01ca0984268a808a04.
Eight renderer-domain tests pass, including exact scheme-prefix forms https:evil.invalid/... and mailto:user@example.invalid/... in both route and navigation-href boundaries.
All 55 governed Python files pass formatting, lint, and type checks after the expanded bundled-browser regression.
The full T02 renderer range remains exactly bound to approved reference RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.3/package db13c8d5... with no protected-control or reference drift.

evidence: Every decoded path segment beginning with an RFC-style scheme prefix is rejected, including non-hierarchical and browser-resolved relative scheme forms.
The frame now evaluates every anchor and removes stale aria-current state from any link that is not a canonical approved local route; invalid links are also absent from delegated keyboard navigation.
Pure route and frame tests cover HTTPS and mailto scheme-prefix forms alongside all prior encoding, traversal, separator, malformed-input, query, fragment, and approved-route cases.
The built-runtime regression mutates the real approved study-design navigation link, verifies it is not current, and verifies ArrowDown does not route focus through it.

The correction remains inside renderer route/frame normalization and its verification harness; no project lifecycle, filesystem, service, dependency, native privilege, or approved reference bytes changed.
The immutable evidence chain preserves both independent review findings and their exact correction ranges.

reviewerDisposition.note: Independent re-review must reproduce scheme-prefixed route and navigation-href forms in the exact production bundle, confirm stale aria-current removal and keyboard exclusion, and validate the full evidence chain before approval.
